description: Topographic Mapping – Edge of Road is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. Polygon layer representing the physical area of the City’s street system. Part of the City’s topographic mapping products, the data is collected from high resolution aerial photography. The data is a representation of the physical features that are visually identifiable in an aerial photograph. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
